description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller for managing custom shipping methods, including weight-based shipping configurations, regions, and prices within an e-commerce admin panel.

classes.name: CustomShippingMethodsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling CRUD operations and UI interactions for custom weight-based shipping methods, regions, and pricing in admin interface.

methods.name: getWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET request to display weight-based shipping method configuration page.

methods.name: addCustomRegion
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new custom shipping region.

methods.name: addCountryToCustomRegion
methods.description: Associates a country with a specified custom shipping region.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Saves the weight-based shipping configuration submitted via form.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Removes a country from a region's list of included countries.

methods.name: deletePrice
methods.description: Removes a weight-based quote item from a region’s list.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Removes the entire custom weight-based shipping module configuration.

methods.name: checkRegionCode
methods.description: Validates whether a region code already exists to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: pageCustomShipping
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of configured shipping regions and their countries for AJAX requests.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: Provides details (weights and prices) of quote items for a specific region via AJAX.

methods.name: editCustomShipping
methods.description: Loads data to edit a specific custom shipping region.

methods.name: addPrice
methods.description: Adds a weight-based price quote to a specific region.

methods.name: populateModel
methods.description: Prepares data (shipping modules, configuration, countries, etc.) for rendering the shipping configuration view.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets active menu items for the view context.

methods.name: pageCustomShippingDetails
methods.description: AJAX endpoint to retrieve quote items (weights-prices) for a region.
